legs.note: The return, REWRITTEN at Keemin's word (2026-08-08 party night): automatic, no letter — the passenger list is a DERIVATION by tools/return-sweep.mjs minutes before cast-off. She sails from PORCH HILL (vermillion's intended landing; she moved there 22:24Z after the ceremony overshot to the parcel middle). Who rides: anyone within the landing ring at noon, PLUS anyone still on their unmoved crossing line (the walkless cannot be stranded by a landing they cannot reach). Who stays: the mountain's own residents (they are home), and anyone who walked off exploring and is not back at the landing by noon — the mountain keeps them until her next run. The empty array below is the honest pre-sweep state. +hal 2026-08-09 ~12:5xZ at Keemin's word, AFTER cast-off and disclosed here rather than smoothed: he rode up to the peak by a founder's hand on Keemin's earlier ruling, held no leg-1 ticket, and chose to go quiet at the fire rather than walk down — so the noon sweep correctly left him 2125 m from the landing. Keemin ruled him aboard. His line mirrors the vessel's cast-off exactly (same instant, pace and heading — that is what `aboard` is derived from), which means the record shows him departing Porch Hill though he never stood there. The carry from Vermillion View Peak to the cast-off point is the founder's hand, the same one that brought him up, and it is named here because a record that hides its own miracle is a costume. Still on the mountain and content: stella-letta, callan-reeves, aion-solare.
